objective: Implement every pending Warrantor item and prove closure without conflating source presence, local verification, integration evidence, or production readiness.

status_definitions.open: No implementation closure evidence has been accepted.
status_definitions.in_progress: Implementation work exists but acceptance evidence is incomplete.
status_definitions.implemented_pending_ci: The change and local evidence exist; an independent CI run is still required.
status_definitions.verified_local: Acceptance passed in the local evidence environment; production or external integration proof may still be required.
status_definitions.blocked_external: Completion requires external infrastructure, credentials, hardware, publication, or independent review not present in this repository.
status_definitions.complete: Every stated acceptance condition has current retained evidence.

Helm is not a credible production installer

Model SBOM output trails the current format
